statements: Constructor compatibility transaction unchanged and excluded from zero-write assertion was true only for the first implementation.
Cold startup limitation is addressed for the tested Workspace recovery paths; normal maintenance is now deferred.
Shared auth protection is retained, but the new application now defaults closed pending an explicit availability decision.

changes.coldRecovery: Constructor only validates/normalizes the journal in memory; recovery snapshot and receipt exclude persistent startup maintenance.
changes.normalMaintenance: The original startup transaction is memoized at all 98 normal public RPC/handler/alarm boundaries. No journal migration or Preview discovery algorithm changes.
changes.guardedReceipts: Recovery receipt returns unavailable before cold Beta/G5 binding-authority RPCs; original normal receipt retains authoritative binding verification.
changes.authentication: TWO_ACCOUNT_AUTH_MODE defaults disabled. Exact accepted values disabled/shared-limited; invalid values and incomplete rollback configuration fail closed.
changes.defaultClosedResponse: 503 two_account_auth_disabled before auth/storage/outbound work on the actual Gateway transport routes.
changes.limits: Original database protection remains: 30/60s basic configuration and installed BetterAuth 1.7.3 sign-in/sign-up default 3/10s rule. No forwarded-IP trust, limit increase or tracking disable.
